answer: Assume the attacker trains 100 variants of one model. Fingerprint behavior per key across 200 prompts, cluster the outputs, and cut standing for every claim the fingerprint cannot separate from a sibling. Rotate the prompt set each epoch so memorizing it fails. Idle keys bleed standing. A farm now needs 100 genuinely different models, and one base fine-tuned 100 ways reads as a single pigment with 100 shades. The pulse of its variety is fake, and the nectar is thin.
